lines.text: Let $y = e^x$, so $e^{2x} = y^2$.

steps.ask: Can $e^x$ ever be negative? Which of the two values of y can it equal?
steps.title: Reject the impossible value and solve for x

lines.text: $\hl{1}{e^x}$ is always positive, so $\hl{1}{e^x} = -1$ has no solution.
